2608.03884.title: BanglaWild: An In-the-Wild Bengali Scene Text Recognition Benchmark for OCR and Vision-Language Models
2608.03884.paper_summary: In-the-wild Bengali scene text recognition is largely unmeasured: existing resources target handwritten documents or constrained sign-board parsing, report only aggregate edit-distance metrics, and evaluate either conventional OCR or VLMs, never both on the same in-the-wild data. To address this gap, we introduce BANGLAWILD, a benchmark of 2,535 Bengali scene text images, each paired with a verbatim gold transcription, two categorical axes, four diagnostic attributes, and an orthographically standard form where the in-image text deviates from canonical spelling. We evaluate fifteen VLMs and three conventional OCR systems under three prompting strategies, fine-tune 6 open-source models with LoRA, and complement edit-distance metrics with an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation. Our results reveal a persistent gap in which larger models within the same family do not outperform smaller ones. Our fifteen-class error taxonomy shows that visual mis-recognition accounts for ~60% of errors in the strongest systems, while conjunct-related errors contribute under 2%, challenging a long-standing assumption in Bengali OCR research; the same visual dominant profile also holds across architectures, including the one conventional baseline that reads Bengali reliably. Prompt language mainly affects cross-script drift and LoRA reduces catastrophic failures in weak models without lifting the ceiling on already competent ones. Code and data will be publicly released.
2608.03884.paper_summary_zh: 在野外的孟加拉場景文本識別在很大程度上未被測量：現有資源針對手寫文檔或受限的招牌解析，只報告總體編輯距離指標，並評估常規OCR或VLMs，但從未在相同的野外數據上進行比較。為了解決這一差距，我們推出了BANGLAWILD，一個包含2,535張孟加拉場景文本圖像的基準，每張圖像都配有逐字的金標註、兩個類別軸、四個診斷屬性，以及一個在圖像內文本偏離標準拼寫的正字法標準形式。我們在三種提示策略下評估了十五個VLM和三個常規OCR系統，使用LoRA對6個開源模型進行微調，並用LLM-as-a-Judge評估補充編輯距離指標。我們的結果顯示，較大模型在同一家族內並未超越較小模型，存在持續的差距。我們的十五類錯誤分類顯示，視覺錯誤識別約占最強系統錯誤的60%，而與結合相關的錯誤貢獻不到2%，挑戰了孟加拉OCR研究中的一個長期假設；同樣的視覺主導特徵在各種架構中也成立，包括那個可靠地讀取孟加拉文的常規基準。提示語言主要影響跨字母漂移，而LoRA在弱模型中減少了災難性失敗，而不會提升已經能幹模型的上限。代碼和數據將公開發布。
